sloka: ततो गिरौ पपातैष इन्द्रवज्राभिताडितः ।पतमानस्य चैतस्य वामो हनुरभज्यत ।। ७.३५.४७ ॥
transliteration: tato girau papātaiṣa indravajrābhitāḍitaḥ ।patamānasya caitasya vāmo hanurabhajyata ।। 7.35.47 ॥

translations.english: Struck by Indra's thunderbolt, the child fell onto the mountain, and as he fell, his left jaw was broken.
